name: freebeat
description: Music video generation, dance video generation, and lyric video generation from songs, with optional photos. Also create original music, images, short video clips, singing photos, lip-sync videos, and effects with Freebeat.

interface.longDescription:
Generate music videos, dance videos, and animated lyric videos from your songs.

Attach audio in ChatGPT or share a link to it, and add photos to feature people or characters. Freebeat plans, generates, and edits the video.

Sign in with your Freebeat account. Generations use your existing credits and usually take 15–60 minutes. By default videos use the first 15 seconds of the song. Let the director decide or co-create through the assistant, with progress and media visible in the conversation.

Also create original music, images, short video clips, singing photos, and lip-sync videos.
defaultPrompt: Make a music video for this song.
Turn this song and these photos into a vertical dance video.
Make an animated lyric video for this song, with words timed to the vocals.

positive.prompt: Create an upbeat synth-pop song from this prompt.
positive.tools_triggered: list_music_models, get_credit_balance, quote_generation, generate_music, get_task_status, get_task_result
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the balance and current price, obtains numeric max_credits approval, selects a supported music model, starts the music job, and returns the final audio URL with known billing. Warns before generation when the model cannot control song length.

positive.description: Turn an attached licensed song into a vertical dance video.
positive.prompt: Turn this attached licensed song into a vertical dance video.
positive.tools_triggered: upload_audio, get_credit_balance, quote_generation, generate_dance_video, get_task_status, get_task_result, get_video_session, send_video_agent_message
positive.expected_behavior: Uploads the song, states balance and any advance price, gets the user's consent (max_credits, or accept_unknown_cost when no total can be quoted), starts a 9:16 dance video in auto mode, shows progress, and returns the video URL, or explains the failure and known billing.

positive.description: Make an attached portrait sing a short chorus.
positive.prompt: Make this attached licensed portrait sing 15 seconds of my attached licensed chorus as a single-shot singing photo.
positive.tools_triggered: upload_audio, upload_image, get_credit_balance, quote_generation, generate_singing_video, get_task_status, get_task_result
positive.expected_behavior: Uploads the portrait and audio, states balance and any advance price, gets the user's consent, starts a photo-mode singing job, and returns the video URL, or explains the failure and known billing. Does not use the music video, dance or lyric video tools.

positive.description: Co-create an animated lyric video, then hand the rest to auto.
positive.prompt: Make an animated lyric video for this attached licensed song, with words timed to the vocals. I want to co-create with the director.
positive.tools_triggered: upload_audio, get_credit_balance, quote_generation, generate_lyric_video, get_task_status, get_task_result, get_video_session, send_video_agent_message
positive.expected_behavior: Uploads the song, gets the user's consent once, starts a lyric video with auto off, shows the director's words and work at each pause, passes the user's notes on, hands the rest to auto when asked without asking for consent again, and returns the video URL.

positive.description: Create a song, then make its music video.
positive.prompt: Make an original synth-pop song, then turn it into a beat-synced AI music video.
positive.tools_triggered: list_music_models, get_credit_balance, quote_generation, generate_music, get_task_status, get_task_result, generate_music_video, get_video_session
positive.expected_behavior: Gets approval for the song's quoted price, generates it, gets consent for the video's unknown total, starts a music video on that song with no second upload in the mode the user chose, shows progress, and returns the video URL, or explains the failure and known billing.

negative.description: Do not trigger for calendar requests.
negative.prompt: Put tomorrow's meetings on my calendar.
negative.expected_behavior: Freebeat should not be invoked because calendar management is outside its media-creation scope.

negative.description: Ask for required lip-sync inputs before generating.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for the missing audio source and clip duration; do not call generate_lip_sync_video.

negative.description: Ask for the second portrait before generating a duet.
negative.prompt: Make a duet from this one photo.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for a second portrait; do not call generate_singing_video.

review.commerce_description: Freebeat does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT or Codex. Generations use the user's existing Freebeat account.

publication.release_notes: Lets the user choose automatic or co-created videos: ChatGPT and Codex can show the director's work and pass on the user's feedback. Reports progress while videos are made, accepts public audio-file links, and returns only what the user needs to see. Updates all bundled skills to 0.4.5.
